You'll have to watch a flashback from fifteen years ago first. After being
introduced to Yuri's overly-awesome father, Colonel Ben Hyuga, you'll have to
fight a battle as him. In the battle, feel free to fuse into the Czernobog and
use the Seventh Key item on one of the Kappas, and with you hitting as many of
the spots on the Judgment Ring as you can, watch as he obliterates both of the
Kappas and Wugui in a single round.

Afterward, you'll regain control as Zhuzhen in the Cypress Hotel in Shanghai.
The Silent Peddler is here beside your room, but again, I recommend saving your
points until you are able to get the best prize first. Use the Save Point on
the ground floor and feel free to talk to Margarete. Head out into the city.

From the entrance to the hotel, take a couple steps south and open the chest
for a [_PILGRIM'S STAFF_] for Zhuzhen; be sure to equip it to him. Make your
way out into the intersection in the street here. To your southeast is a man in
purple, standing on a red mat; search the ground beside the wagon with a barrel
just below that man (Hasty Kawa) for a [_LOTTERY TICKET_]. From there, go down
the nearby stairs to your south and examine the barrel at the very bottom of
the screen for a [_MANA SEED_].

Depending on how close you get to the stairs here to the west, you'll see an
event. This is where we're supposed to go next, but there are still some items
to be found first. Head back to the intersection and go east to the next area.

Go right, then follow the wall as you go south until you run across a '?' icon
at the yellow banner; check here for a [_TALISMANOFMERCY_]. Keep following
along the eastern wall until you come across another '?' icon near a long red
banner; check here for a [_B.DRAGON HORN_]. To your left from here is a blue
door; this is actually a shop (Mika's House), but save shopping here for just a
little later when we have another discount card. Continue southwest to the next
area.

Descend the stairs here, then examine the barrel next to the green archway for
a [_SEAL OF LIFE_]. Make your way south and down into the area below deck on
the boat. Talk to the boy here, and you'll find out that he's a Lottery Member!

The ring here moves REALLY fast, so remember, equipping the Pocket Watch will
make it easier to hit the areas! Make sure to win the Star Card before
continuing on; it allows you to get up to 20% off on your purchases, and 10%
more on your sales! If you don't win it, reload your last save and try again.
Remember, you need to win something from each member at least once!

When you're done, head back to the intersection near the hotel and go south at
the intersection, then down the stairs to your west for an event (if you
haven't seen it yet.) In the bar here, examine the barrel at the bottom-right
of the screen to find another [_LOTTERY TICKET_].

Talk to the man at the bar to start a series of events. You'll eventually have
two different battles against a Kappa each time. Just cast Ogre Flamedance and
heal, if necessary. After those two are finished, you'll take on Wugui, but to
no avail. You cannot win, so just defend and let him take you out with his Game
of Death. Once that battle is over, Yuri will step in and you'll have to take
him on once again.

Watch the long series of events afterward, and you'll regain control in the
hotel room. Before moving on, there's a couple more things we can do in
Shanghai. Save first.

At the intersection by the hotel, there's a stand just to your right before
going to the next screen. Talk to Lamenting Clerk Kuro; now that Wugui is gone,
you can buy weapons here, so make sure to upgrade!

For shopping recommendations, I recommend buying a decent amount of the new 2nd
level recovery items (Thera/Mana/Pure Seed and TalismanOfMercy), as well as
upgrading everyone's weapons, armor, and buying four (this time) each of the
Studded Caps and Western Belts, as all four party members will be participating
in the next dungeon.

  NOTE     Not only can you talk to Meiyuan in Zhen's Bar to have him do
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   Acupuncture, but he can also change out your party for you! Take
           advantage of that to equip your party as you like.

Once you're done shopping, make your way back to the bar, and examine the
curtain on the top part of the room. Mr. Zhen is now hosting pit fights! Right
now, you won't make it very far before you're killed, but you're welcome to
try! We'll come back to this after a while, when we're a lot stronger and are
able to finish it, but just know that it's here.

When you're ready, go to the intersection near the hotel and head north out to
the World Map. Make your way over to the Temple Ruins next.
